facts: 傍晚時，陽光要穿過更厚的空氣

紅色和橘色的光比較能穿過來

question_patterns: why is the sky red at sunset

en.first_sentence: The sky turns red at sunset because sunlight passes through thick air.
facts: At sunset, sunlight has to go through more air.
Blue light gets spread out by the air on the way.
Red and orange light can reach our eyes.
en.ask_back: Do you think the sky is redder at sunset, or at noon?

bridges.has_garden: Have you watched a red sunset from your garden?
